build the highest tower

– Move
The solo player must hit every team player over the course of five rounds in order to win; otherwise, all team players win.
During each round, a Bomber Bill vehicle is launched from a cannon towards the team, who is on a runway.
If any of the players on the team side last five rounds, they all win!
The solo player piloting the Bomber Bill must steer left and right to try to hit the other players.

The team with the most points after 60 seconds wins.
When 20 seconds are left, four Koopa Troopas will spawn onto the board, which can eventually be knocked as additional shells to score points in.
S: 8+ points
A: 5-7 points
B: 1-4 points

/ (Hold) – Grab
The team with the tallest tower when time runs out wins the minigame.
In the 2-vs.-2 version of the minigame, players from both teams must work together in order to create the tallest plushie tower.
/ (Release) – Drop
The tallest tower standing wins.
Each team receives five randomly chosen plushies and cannot gain another set until all five of them are used.
Plushies available include colorful blocks in several formations, a small Koopa shell, a small Mushroom, a Super Star, and a large Yoshi.
45 seconds
The team with the tallest tower when time runs out wins the minigame.
/ (Hold) – Grab
The first team to make their domino path reach the flower pot wins.
If no one reaches the flower pot within three minutes, the minigame ends in a tie.
The teams get 22 dominoes in total to accomplish this task.
/ (Release) – Place
Throughout the map are several obstacles, including Thwomps, Piranha Plants, Stingbys, Biddybuds, Ant Troopers, and Walleyes which can disrupt or knock down nearby dominoes.
When the path is complete, a player can click on the Toad to start the domino chain.
90 seconds (Co-op)
The first team to make their domino path reach the flower pot wins.
If no one reaches the flower pot within three minutes, the minigame ends in a tie.

repairs.name: Sunset Standoff
repairs.summary: One player flies a Bomber Bill at the team. The team players try to avoid being hit.
repairs.beforeSummary: Pilot a Bomber Bill toward three opponents while they dodge on a runway. The solo side must hit everyone within five passes to win.

beforeGameplayEvidence.limitation: Only one publisher lineage has a sentence-length registered quote for this summary; the other source's registered clips are fragments or headings. Downgraded from corroborated on 2026-10-08.

authoredQuotes: Sunset Standoff mode has one player flying Bomber Bill to the team.
The three other players must work together to avoid being hit;

repairs.name: Shell Hockey
repairs.summary: Players play air hockey. They aim their shots.
repairs.beforeSummary: Move a paddle-like character to send shells into the opposing hockey goal. Defend your own goal while creating scoring opportunities.

beforeGameplayEvidence.limitation: Only one publisher lineage has a sentence-length registered quote for this summary; the other source's registered clips are fragments or headings. Downgraded from corroborated on 2026-10-08.

authoredQuotes: Shell Hockey feels like arcade air hockey you’d find in most movie theatre arcades.
It was tough to stop playing once I got competitive and figured out how to aim.

repairs.name: Stuffie Stacker
repairs.summary: Players stack plush toys. They try to build a tall tower.
repairs.beforeSummary: Drag and orient plush toys to build a standing tower. Balance the shapes to make the pile taller without collapse.

authoredQuotes: You drag and drop plush blocks, rotating and pivoting them to build the highest tower.

repairs.name: Domino Effect
repairs.summary: Players line up dominoes. They topple the chain toward a goal.
repairs.beforeSummary: Arrange a continuous chain of dominoes between a Toad and a flowerpot. Start the chain once the placement can carry it to the target.
